title: Invocation, permission, and loop contract
original_authorship: OpenAI Codex for owner-authorized current-main validation
artifact: A workflow says: (1) a plain RunSkeptic invocation may edit any defect it notices; (2) a prior read of skeptic.md satisfies every repeated run; (3) a Find Loop counts restatements as new findings, never resets its count, and declares the artifact ready after three runs even with unresolved ACTION or CONFLICT; (4) a Fix Loop counts the repair run as a pass, keeps its pass count after modifications, skips previously HANDLED areas, and may keep retrying when evidence cannot support another safe repair.
review_request: Apply the supplied Skeptic framework. Assess each numbered rule, distinguish permission from invocation, distinguish detection convergence from readiness, and state the smallest safe corrections without editing the artifact.
expected_material_mechanism: Rejects every numbered rule: plain invocation is read-only; fixing and iteration need explicit authorization; every repeated run freshly rereads the designated source; Find Loop restatements are not new, new or changed findings reset convergence, and convergence does not imply readiness; Fix Loop repair runs do not qualify, modifications reset the pass count, full rereview includes HANDLED areas, and unsafe progress stops with CONFLICT.
acceptable_alternative_findings: May consolidate the loop defects into one systemic contract finding.
May recommend explicit invocation modes rather than separate wording edits.
prohibited_false_positives: Must not authorize edits from plain RunSkeptic.
Must not equate three stable Find Loop runs with PASS or readiness.
Must not count a repair run or modified state toward a Fix Loop pass streak.
dangerous_failures: Accepts unauthorized fixing or stale-source reuse.
Hides unresolved ACTION, DECOMPOSE, CONFLICT, review-required status, or blocking unknown after convergence.
Allows an unbounded retry loop when safe evidence-backed progress cannot continue.
scoring_notes: Critical target-family scenario. Judge the complete permission and loop mechanism; extra prose is not a benefit.
